label: Canada's Stablecoin Act receives assent; financial-institution issuers excluded
note: Bill C-15 (S.C. 2026, c. 3) puts non-financial-institution issuers under Bank of Canada registration from a date set by order (Finance Canada expects 2027). Section 12 excludes, subject to regulations, issuers that are financial institutions; the Bank Act s. 2 definition includes trust corporations incorporated under provincial law, which appears to cover Tetra Trust, CADD's Alberta-chartered issuer.

label: CADD launch, Canada's first regulated CAD-backed stablecoin
note: 2026-05-04: Tetra Digital Group launches CADD as Canada's first regulated CAD-backed stablecoin
